subtasks.title: Establish a hermetic media fixture at the first-arm seam
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: architecture/system_context.md § BUG-001: _build_default_ducker is inert until _arm; the earlier ducking_heal.read_ducked_flag can independently start a live heal. There is no existing tests/conftest.py.
2. INPUT: voice_typing/daemon.py:VoiceTypingDaemon(..., ducker=), _build_default_ducker, and tests/test_key_listener.py:_wire_daemon with fake recorder/backend/mic.
3. LOGIC: Add an opt-in, function-scoped tests/conftest.py fixture hermetic_daemon_media. Give it a helper callable (cfg) -> cfg that makes a test-owned config with duck_mode='off' and private test state; preserve unrelated fields and never mutate a production default or a shared supplied config. Provide a fail-closed check at the daemon's factory lookup and isolate persisted duck-flag reads on fixture invocation, not at collection. Apply it at _wire_daemon/arming callers. Mock real media, recorder, mic and backend; never globally patch subprocess.run or allow a real media command to prove failure.
4. OUTPUT: hermetic_daemon_media fixture and migrated key-listener arms consumed by P1.M1.T1.S2 and P1.M1.T1.S3. Ordinary arm/stop starts neither vt-ducking nor vt-duck-heal, even if operator state would say ducked; unguarded factory use under the fixture fails synchronously.
5. DOCS: none — test-only contract; document fixture use and intentional fake-heal exceptions in its docstring.

subtasks.title: Start the production IM route on the bulk arm worker
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: architecture/bulk_delivery_gate.md § feasibility: _build_default_bulk_target never starts ImeProcess; ImeTarget.acquire requests only a running process. G5 GtkRoute masks the gap with a lab-side spawn/ping bridge.
2. INPUT: P1.M1.T1.S2 hermetic daemon tests and P1.M1.T3.S1 baseline; daemon.py:_BulkTargetBundle/_bulk_begin_delivery, ime/manager.py:ImeProcess.spawn/request/stop, ime/target.py:ImeTarget.acquire, ime/ime_host.py ping/activated behavior.
3. LOGIC: Keep construction pure. On vt-bulk-arm outside the daemon lock, attach the fresh takeover watcher, start the production IM child, boundedly pump read-only activation and then acquire; reject stale epochs or disarm races without publishing active. Preserve unsupported/held-seat semantics, concise reason, bounded cleanup on failure, and no retry of possibly applied edits. Mock ImeProcess/request and time, fake target and recorder; cover never-activated, held seat, fresh rearm and stop during startup.
4. OUTPUT: Production GTK can acquire through the default daemon factory without the lab bridge; P1.M2.T1.S4 consumes that exact route in the disposable compositor.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Update _BulkTargetBundle/_build_default_bulk_target JSDoc-equivalent docstrings and README.md Troubleshooting § Bulk delivery: the input-method seat is taken as needed for actual acquire/failure behavior; overview remains for P1.M2.T3.S2.

subtasks.context_scope:

Match changed spans and retain first real aligned appearance across revisions and repeats; exclude pre-existing anchor text and resets. Distinguish missing, ambiguous and superseded observations and preserve the zero-edit oracle for rendered-identical updates; do not charge a delayed frame to a newer identical callback. Preserve floors, latency caps, backlog and dump rules. Mock clocks and use synthetic field traces incl. lost frames, revisions, burst inputs and unpaired events, not live GUI.

subtasks.title: Keep partial dispatch prompt and fail closed under bursts
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: architecture/bulk_delivery_gate.md § feasibility: current writer already wakes on enqueue, same-key replacement is checked after capacity, and overflow can bypass the stop hook. Confirm stage attribution before calling coalescing the cause.
2. INPUT: P1.M2.T1.S6 stage diagnosis; voice_typing/bulk_controller.py on_partial/on_final/on_final_dropped/arm/_process_next and voice_typing/bulk_delivery.py DeliveryTarget/ShowResult/rendered_equal.
3. LOGIC: Make the first useful pending partial dispatch promptly without waiting on a final; coalesce only already queued same-key partials in place, retaining FIFO barriers. Allow legal replacement at capacity, stop once on real overflow and notify outside locks. Preserve mutation-time generation/closure/cancel/epoch checks, one writer/one op, zero-diff suppression, the 250 ms deadline, and ack-only revision/confirmation. Assert a stream of spaced distinct partials sends show before final, and burst/stall cases retain newest-partial and fail-closed semantics; inject fake DeliveryTarget/events/manual clock via tests/test_bulk_controller.py drain and tests/test_g2_bulk_gate.py. Do not slow the reader, increase queue/deadline to mask lag, or add typing fallback.
4. OUTPUT: Existing BulkController entry/target interfaces with verified pre-final progress and backpressure behavior; usable by P1.M2.T2.S2 and P1.M2.T2.S3.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Update BulkController module and changed method docstrings for exact dispatch/overflow invariants; keep user overview for P1.M2.T3.S2.

subtasks.title: Remediate the measured source-to-field bottleneck
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: architecture/bulk_delivery_gate.md separates recognition, relay, writer and target time; both upstream callbacks share a decode gate in 1.0.2.
2. INPUT: P1.M2.T1.S6 paired visibility/diagnosis and P1.M2.T2.S1 controller progress contract. Candidate seams are daemon.py:_build_callbacks/_bulk_handle_partial, recorder_host.py:_RelayFeedback.update_partial/_dispatch, and ImeTarget/PiEditorTarget show paths as measured.
3. LOGIC: Use the earliest useful callback by visible lag, not name. If source selection and the controller fix alone do not address the measured gap, change the dominant measured stage only: e.g. bulk-only evaluation cadence for late eligible decodes, prompt routing of usable updates for relay lag, or eliminate measured redundant adapter waits only if ownership/caret and one-edit proofs remain intact. Preserve stream-edit ASR/control behavior, final filtering, R.6 recovery, takeover and no-retry safety. Do not invent text between callbacks or remove guards. Mock recorder/relay clock and target transports for the stage-specific regression; exercise tests/test_bulk_dispatch.py, tests/test_bulk_context_prompt.py and tests/test_session_recovery.py where affected. If evidence is unavailable or a safe fix requires a separate design, publish the exact blocker instead of guessing or dropping safeguards.
4. OUTPUT: Bounded candidate diff/settings and regression proof or explicit remaining blocker for P1.M2.T2.S3.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Record changed callback/cadence or adapter contracts in touched symbol docstrings and candidate settings/reason in tests/G5_TIMING_EVIDENCE.md; no new end-user knob.

subtasks.title: Qualify the selected production source on both routes
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: architecture/bulk_delivery_gate.md § Gate: G5 is per route and G6 is separate. Target ack, editor-poll state and no-desktop smoke are not display frames.
2. INPUT: P1.M2.T1.S4 runner, P1.M2.T1.S5 Pi observation, P1.M2.T1.S6 paired report, P1.M2.T2.S1/P1.M2.T2.S2 candidate, and P1.M1.T3.S1 exact legacy set.
3. LOGIC: Compare both callbacks again under candidate scheduling if behavior materially changed. Select the better qualifying mode internally for bulk only and re-run the production selection (no experimental override) independently on both isolated routes. Require speech-end-to-word-visible median <=500 ms/p95 <1000 ms, ready-to-first-changed-frame insertion/correction p95 <=100/50 ms, >=100 real insertions and >=100 corrections per route, zero unchanged edits, no sustained >=5-word backlog for >=2 s, no sentence-end dump, and honest coverage/clock sanity. Use GNU timeout -k 2 1500 per route with larger harness backstop; only fake transports for pure tests and no live desktop. Compare bounded CPU failures by node ID to P1.M1.T3.S1; honor existing real-model watch policy separately and don't claim it ran if unavailable. If a route fails, cannot certify frames, or is unrun, retain opt-in, don't promote an unproven source as the fix, and leave BUG-002/acceptance #13 open with exact blocker.
4. OUTPUT: tests/G5_TIMING_EVIDENCE.md authoritative current two-route verdict (pass/fail/blocked even when unverified) plus separate historical and exploratory evidence, effective source, exact commands, provenance and safety limits for P1.M2.T3.S1/P1.M2.T3.S2. A verified bulk source does not change default delivery.
5. DOCS: [Mode A] Update G5 verdict table/methodology and selected callback rationale in daemon.py. Preserve parsing format for the authoritative table; historical/A-B tables must not be parsed as current route verdicts.
